summary_en: This study tests the CivaSheet, a flat, low-dose-rate (LDR) directional radiation implant, combined with external beam radiation for pancreatic cancer that is borderline resectable or locally advanced. The sheet is placed during surgery, either a Whipple procedure or a distal pancreatectomy, and how long it stays in place or how often it is given is not stated. The study measures local control and the preferred method of attaching the sheet, and it is a Phase 1/Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba la CivaSheet, un implante de radiación plano de baja tasa de dosis (LDR) y direccional, combinado con radioterapia de haz externo para el cáncer de páncreas que es borderline resecable o localmente avanzado. El implante se coloca durante la cirugía, ya sea un procedimiento de Whipple o una pancreatectomía distal, y no se indica cuánto tiempo permanece colocado ni con qué frecuencia se administra. El estudio mide el control local y el método preferido para fijar la lámina, y es un estudio de Fase 1/Fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 or older who signed informed consent.
Scheduled for a Whipple procedure or distal pancreatectomy.
Borderline resectable or locally advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma, without metastatic disease.
Neoadjuvant chemoradiation given 4 to 10 weeks before surgery.
not_for: Other invasive cancer in the past 5 years, except basal or squamous cell skin cancer.
History of alcoholism or drug abuse, or currently in other clinical trials.
